name: Telugu New Tab Calendar (పంచాంగం)
shortDescription: Offline Telugu Panchangam, daily Rasi Phalalu, Rahu Kalam and festival calendar on your new tab.
description:
Telugu New Tab Calendar (పంచాంగం) turns your Chrome new tab into a Telugu Vedic calendar for the Telugu community worldwide.

Features:
- Daily Panchangam: Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga and Karana, calculated for your location.
- Rahu Kalam, Yamagandam and Gulika Kalam timings.
- Daily Rasi Phalalu (రాశి ఫలాలు) for all 12 rasis.
- Festivals and vratams (Ugadi, Vinayaka Chavithi, Dasara, Sankranti and more) with reminders.
- Vedic Sankalpam text generator with the correct Samvatsara, Ayana, Ritu and Masa.

Privacy: calculations run inside your browser. No tracking or analytics. Your approximate location is used only to compute timings for your location.
